evidence.verbatim_selected_text: `select_mask` creates a boolean mask from the **current target layer** when this operation runs. It changes no image pixels. Required fields: `name`, `selector`. Optional `combine`: `replace` (default), `add`, `subtract`, `intersect`.

| Selector | Fields | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rectangle` | `region: [x0,y0,x1,y1]` | Select every pixel in the rectangle |
| `polygon` | `points: [[x,y],...]` | Filled polygon, including its boundary; 3–1000 points |
| `color` | `colors: ["#rgba",...]`, optional `region`, `tolerance` | Match 1–256 colors, including disconnected islands |
| `contiguous` | `seed: [x,y]`, optional `region`, `tolerance`, `connectivity` | Connected component matching the seed color |
| `alpha` | Optional `min`, `max`, `region` | Select alpha in the inclusive range; defaults 1–255 (visible pixels) |

Every selector includes `kind`. Tolerance defaults to zero. It is the maximum difference allowed in **each RGB channel relative to the original seed/listed color**, from 0–255. Alpha must match exactly; RGB beneath zero alpha is ignored. Connectivity is 4 by default, optionally 8. A region limits both selection and connected traversal. A contiguous selector with a seed outside its region returns an empty mask.
